description.value: Fish O Chips is a local fish-and-chips restaurant in Sidney, BC serving classic battered fish fare for both dine-in guests and takeout customers. The dining room is currently open, and takeout orders are packed with the same care as a dine-in meal. A June 2025 menu is available as a downloadable PDF from the website.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Fish O Chips is an active dine-in and takeout fish-and-chips restaurant at 10153 Resthaven Drive, Sidney BC; the phone number (250-656-4435) matches OSM exactly. Takeout is explicitly confirmed via a dedicated takeout menu page and the phrase 'WE WILL PACK IT JUST LIKE IF YOU WERE DINING IN.' No website content mentions bike parking, water refill, or washrooms, so those required criteria remain null; the menu is only available as a PDF and could not be read for dietary options.
concerns: OSM address field is empty; address '10153 Resthaven Drive, Sidney, BC' sourced from website content only.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The restaurant is a legitimate and active food stop in a cycling-friendly area, but all three required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are unconfirmed from available evidence; a site visit or direct contact is needed before inclusion.
